text:
Chulent

Ingredients:
- 1 onion, chopped (medium dice)
- Oil, enough to coat the bottom of the crock pot (any type)
- Navy beans and pinto beans: about a 10-ounce disposable soup bowl, three-quarters full of navy beans and one-quarter full of pinto beans, checked for rocks and bad beans
- Barley, about 6 ounces by volume
- Flank steak or chulent meat
- 1-2 russet potatoes, depending on size
- 1 tablespoon salt
- 3 tablespoons onion powder
- 1 1/2 tablespoons garlic powder
- Black pepper, a sprinkle
- Cayenne pepper, a little (not a lot)
- Crushed red pepper, a little
- Paprika, a sprinkle
- Honey, about 2 tablespoons
- Barbecue sauce, about 3 tablespoons
- Kishka, 3 slices
- Water, enough to just about cover the potatoes

Instructions:
1. Put a thin layer of oil on the bottom of the crock pot. Add the chopped onion.
2. Add the beans and the barley.
3. Add the meat.
4. Place the potatoes on top of the meat, so the meat is not the top layer.
5. Add the salt, onion powder, garlic powder, black pepper, cayenne pepper, crushed red pepper, and paprika.
6. Add the honey and barbecue sauce.
7. Add the kishka slices.
8. Add enough water to just about cover the potatoes.
9. Cook on low in the crock pot until ready the next day.
